# Legislation and LGBTQ+ Populations in the 2026 U.S. Midterms

By Dhara, Julia, and Allie

a short description of the project 
> We will use 2026 midterm election data (states and cities/metro areas) and data on estimates of LGBTQ+ populations in US states and cities to evaluate the correlation between anti-LGBTQ+ legislation and LGBTQ+ populations.

2-3 broad research questions the team is interested in exploring the
reasons/inspirations behind choosing the topic
> Does proportionality of LGBTQ populations by state correlate to whether anti-LGBTQ+ legislation is passed?

> Does proportionality of trans populations by state affect the presence of anti-trans legislation?

one potential data set that can be used to answer the research questions

> https://williamsinstitute.law.ucla.edu/publications/lgbt-us-msa/
> https://williamsinstitute.law.ucla.edu/publications/trans-adults-united-states/
> https://ballotpedia.org/Ballot_measures_related_to_sex-based_sports_eligibility_and_medical_proc\>edures_for_transgender_minors,\_2026
> https://www.aclu.org/legislative-attacks-on-lgbtq-rights-2026
> https://www.headcount.org/ballot-initiatives/2026-lgbtq-ballot-measures-final
